title: If-Else Statements
description: Make decisions in your code using if, else if, and else blocks, plus comparison and logical operators.

slides.title: The Decision Maker 🤔

quizData.question: What does an if statement do?

options.text: Runs code only when a condition is true

quizData.explanation: if checks a condition; the body executes only when the condition is true.

slides.title: Else & Else If ↔️

quizData.question: What will be printed? int x = 10; if (x > 5) Debug.Log("A"); else Debug.Log("B");
quizData.explanation: 10 > 5 is true, so the if block runs, printing A.

slides.title: Comparison & Logical Operators 🔍

quizData.question: What does this evaluate to? (true || false) && (3 > 2)
quizData.explanation: (true || false) = true; (3 > 2) = true; true && true = true.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Avoid Double Comparisons

Don't write `if (health == true)`. Just `if (health)` is enough for bools. For falseness, `if (!health)`.
